message.content: {"version":"1","text":"This ensemble is a study in contrasts and textures, perfect for your morning yoga routine. It blends a soft, romantic top with a structured skirt, anchored by an oversized coat and finished with comfortable sneakers that let you move freely from the studio to a café. The plum cardigan offers a deep, cozy hue that pairs beautifully with the muted green of the skirt, while the gold necklace adds a touch of elegance without overpowering the relaxed vibe.","how_to_wear":["Wrap the open-front cardigan loosely around your shoulders for a casual look, or cinch it at the waist with a belt to define your silhouette.","Pair the wide-leg skirt with the chunky sneakers to keep the outfit grounded and practical for movement.","Let the gold necklace hang freely near your collarbone to draw attention to your neckline when you take off your coat."],"wrong_photos":[],"swap":{},"about_items":[{"n":"#155·18","text":"A delicate, open-knit cardigan in rich plum with a relaxed, draped silhouette and wide sleeves that flow beautifully over the hips.","n":"#203·27","text":"A floor-length skirt in soft olive green featuring an asymmetrical high slit on one side and voluminous pleats that add movement with every step.","n":"#269·32","text":"A simple gold pendant necklace with a heart-shaped charm on a fine chain, adding a subtle sparkle without overwhelming the outfit.","n":"#460·04","text":"An oversized trench coat in milky cream with a navy collar and striped cuffs, providing warmth and structure to soften the feminine lines of the dress.","n":"#319·03","text":"A structured beige handbag in suede with gold hardware and a circular pouch attached, offering both style and practical storage.","n":"#296·17","text":"Comfortable brown sneakers made of natural suede with white soles, providing cushioning and support for all-day wear."}],"named":[{"n":"#155·18","what":"plum cardigan"},"{"n":"#203·27","what":"olive green skirt"},"{"n":"#269·32","what":"gold necklace"},"{"n":"#460·04","what":"cream trench coat"},"{"n":"#319·03","what":"beige handbag"},"{"n":"#296·17","what":"brown sneakers"}]}
